mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate indicates tight monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer and business spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates indicate a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases when UNRATE is below 4%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts indicate strong demand in the housing market, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases when HOUST increases by more than 5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is low and the federal funds rate is high, it indicates a strong economy with tight monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases when UNRATE is below 4% and FEDFUNDS is above 5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indicates increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases by more than 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases when INDPRO increases by more than 1%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: High GDP growth indicates strong economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales indicate strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by more than 5% year-over-year
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases when RSAFS increases by more than 5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) is high and unemployment (UNRATE) is low, it indicates a potential for monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by more than 3% year-over-year and UNRATE < 4%
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases when CPIAUCSL increases by more than 3% and UNRATE is below 4%, the hypothesis is rejected.
